projects.title: Parallax Institute
projects.tagline: The stewardship and teaching framework connecting Parallax research, prototypes, public evidence, creative work, and regenerative benefit.
projects.story: Parallax Institute gives the body of work a coherent institutional home without pretending that every project is the same kind of object. It connects stewardship, research, prototyping, public explanation, culture, and public benefit through visible evidence, consent, repair, and human authority. EnterTheField.org is the intended public doorway; the Archive preserves projects and receipts; PHI369 Labs names the experimental builder lane; and the future Mt. Shasta / Pilgrim Creek Institute remains a planned physical vision rather than a present facility.
projects.summary: A public institutional identity and architectural framework for moving ideas from imagination through bounded research, prototypes, evidence, repair, teaching, and public benefit. The Institute is not represented by this package as incorporated, accredited, tax-exempt, grantmaking, regulatory, or physically operational.
projects.see: The Institute cover, public ecosystem map, Regenerative Sector Covenant, architecture and status briefs, live Institute Field Map, project relationships, current evidence state, and the explicit boundary between the active public identity and future legal or physical ambitions.
projects.proof: Seven public artifacts are connected, including a live Field Map that reads the canonical Archive Core and groups current projects by curatorial role. The map proves synchronized public presentation, not a legal organization, ownership structure, staff roster, operating campus, or measured sector impact.
projects.next: Freeze a concise public charter, founding-authority statement, role and mandate registry, amendment process, partnership boundary, and project-admission protocol. Separately develop a documented feasibility path for the Mt. Shasta / Pilgrim Creek physical vision without implying secured land, permits, financing, facilities, or operating authority.
projects.claimBoundary: Parallax Institute is currently an active public identity and architectural stewardship framework. This package does not establish incorporation, nonprofit or tax-exempt status, tax-deductible contributions, accreditation, degrees, licensure, clinical services, governmental authority, grantmaking power, physical-campus readiness, ownership of land or facilities, measured regenerative impact, or shared ownership. Collaboration does not automatically confer authority or the right to redirect the founding vision.

relationships.note: ALO preserves project claims, custody, authority, uncertainty, repair, and institutional continuity.
